_comment: ISSUE-KVD-SKILLS-A5ED0D — hybrid mode with the unknown block wedged immediately BEFORE `require_broker`. Case 1 (`git log --oneline` -> 0) discriminates on exit code and proves the allow_bash override still fires. Case 2 (`git log` -> 2) proves the block list still fires AND that the stderr names `kvendra.git`, i.e. the require_broker mapping that FOLLOWS the unknown block was parsed — a dirty parse cursor would have degraded it to the `kvendra.shell` fallback without changing the exit code, which is exactly the kind of silent policy weakening this fixture exists to catch.

extra_cases.expected_stderr_regex: ^\[KVD-PROTECTED\] Bash op .* blocked by policy 'STD-KVD-BROKER-POLICY' v1 \(mode: hybrid\)\. Use broker primitive 'kvendra\.git' instead
